textDesc: Low-top lace-up casual shoes with a round toe and stitched apron profile for everyday outfits. Microfiber synthetic leather upper, PU lining and cemented construction. The source describes a foamed-rubber sole; individual sole-layer formulations are not specified. Black and Khaki options with size labels 38-44. Send colour-size quantities, fit requirements, packaging needs and destination for order-specific availability and dispatch confirmation.
